messages:
Priya: Kicking off Omega Interop POC perf thread. Sales ask: validate 3.3k sustained qps on /v1/complete (chat-ish) with p99 < 190ms for short/medium prompts. They care about burst recovery patterns, streaming vs non-streaming cost delta, and BYOK import timelines. Requested window: Fri 08:30 PT, 2h.

Carlos: I can own the load harness and runbook. Need exact prompt distribution + streaming ratio. Also confirm whether to run hosted only or try a short Dedicated fallback.

Priya: Prompt mix per prospect packet: 66% short (~28 tokens), 29% medium (~140), 5% long (~480). Streaming ratio 30% (higher than usual). Start hosted; if we hit sustained saturation we'll spin a temp dedicated pool. Auth: API key for hosted, service account for Dedicated. Security questionnaire due Thu EOD.

Nate: Ops note: staging has 5x A10G free; can reserve 7 for the window but need quick capacity approval. Important: Omega wants BYOK with HSM import and insists on an import timeline estimate 1: we typically estimate ~96h for full BYOK+peering+cert steps for Private, but hosted envelope BYOK is immediate.

Carlos: Proposed run matrix:
- Ramp: smooth 0 -> 3.3k qps over 14m, hold 50m steady (steady-state telemetry)
- Sawtooth bursts: repeated 45s spikes to 9.9k qps (3x) with 3m recovery to observe backlog and shed behaviour
- Streaming stress: increase streaming concurrency for 20m at 40% of total qps to exercise SSE/WS paths
- Cold priming: spawn 11k new sessions over 12m to measure KV cache warm-up and tail changes
We'll use vegeta for open-loop qps and a small Go streaming client to replicate SSE.

Carlos: Quick vegeta example we'll include in the repo:
```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete" > targets.txt
vegeta attack -rate=3300 -duration=50m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type=hists
```
Requests will include X-Run-ID, X-Trace-ID and token/cost headers to align with console telemetry.

Priya: Acceptance criteria (proposal): p99(short+med) <=190ms steady, error rate <0.35%, tail recovery <=100s after each sawtooth spike, and sustained throughput within 5% of target for 80% of steady window. Collect p50/p90/p99, errors, queue backlog, per-shard GPU util, and streaming vs non-streaming cost per 1M tokens.

sec-bot: Expected security asks: BYOK import steps & timeline (note: ~96h for Private BYOK full flow), HSM attestation (FIPS level), KMS envelope docs, audit log retention, VPC peering diagram, SOC2 report link. If Omega insists on HSM import for the hosted flow, explain tradeoffs and that true HSM import requires Private + 96h prep.

Nate: Capacity request submitted for 7x A10G Fri 07:00-11:30 PT. Also enabling kernel-level tracing and GPU occupancy counters for the window. If we see sustained queueing, we'll test prefix caching and model-shard fallback.

Carlos: I'll push the runbook + scripts to perf/omega and drop the link here. I'll also prepare a tokens->cost quicksheet: rough calc: 3.3k qps * avg 65 tokens/request * 3600s ~= 772M tokens/hour 1 I'll produce a cleaner sheet showing hosted on-demand vs a Dedicated commit example and explicit burst-minute overage math.

Priya: Messaging for pricing: show hosted on-demand estimate, one Dedicated commit example that halves unit cost at scale, and explicit burst overage math (per burst-minute). Also highlight streaming delta (streaming calls often increase end-to-end CPU and slightly higher p99 due to SSE lifecycle).

cap-bot: Reservation submitted. Pending capacity approval and confirmed by Nate.

Carlos: Pre-run checklist I'll include: tracing headers set, sampling 100% during run, dashboards ready (p50/p90/p99, qps, errors, GPU util, queue backlog), and token accounting enabled. Posting checklist 24h before the window.

Nate: :white_check_mark: capacity approved and kernel tracing enabled. I've attached a short note on BYOK timeline to the security doc.

Carlos: :white_check_mark: scripts pushed to perf/omega, runbook drafted. Will post final run link and pre-run checklist 24h out.

sec-bot: :white_check_mark: security bullets drafted and attached to the questionnaire; included BYOK 96h note and required artifacts.

Priya: Thanks everyone 1 this is the canonical thread for Omega perf artifacts and the final results writeup. We'll post post-run summary + slides here after execution.
